blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a nonempty open set in $\mathbb{R}^m$. We make the following definition.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 中非空开集. 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A function $f$ defined on $\Omega$ is called a \textbf{test function} if $f\in C^\infty(\Omega)$ and there is a compact set $K\subset\Omega$ such that the support of $f$ lies in $K$. The set of all test functions on $\Omega$ is denoted by $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)=C_0^\infty(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 若定义在 $\Omega$ 上的函数 $f$ 满足 $f\in C^\infty(\Omega)$, 且存在紧集 $K\subset\Omega$, 使 $f$ 的支集位于 $K$ 中, 则称其为\textbf{试验函数}. $\Omega$ 上所有试验函数构成的集合记为 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)=C_0^\infty(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: def:test-function

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Obviously, $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ is a linear space. To do analysis, we need a notion of convergence. It is possible to define open sets in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ and use the notions of general topology. However, for most purposes in PDEs this is not necessary; only a definition for the convergence of sequences is required. This definition is as follows.
blocks.zh: 显然, $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 是线性空间. 为进行分析, 需要收敛的概念. 可以在 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 中定义开集, 并使用一般拓扑的概念. 然而, 对偏微分方程中的大多数目的, 这并非必要; 只需定义序列的收敛. 定义如下.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\phi_n$, $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\phi$ be elements of $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$. We say that $\phi_n$ \textbf{converges} to $\phi$ in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, if there is a compact subset $K$ of $\Omega$ such that the supports of all the $\phi_n$ (and of $\phi$) lie in $K$ and, moreover, $\phi_n$ and derivatives of $\phi_n$ of arbitrary order converge uniformly to those of $\phi$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\phi_n$, $n\in\mathbb{N}$ 及 $\phi$ 为 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 的元素. 若存在 $\Omega$ 的紧子集 $K$, 使所有 $\phi_n$ (以及 $\phi$) 的支集均位于 $K$ 内, 且 $\phi_n$ 以及 $\phi_n$ 的任意阶导数分别一致收敛到 $\phi$ 及其相应导数, 则称 $\phi_n$ 在 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 中\textbf{收敛}到 $\phi$.
blocks.label: def:test-function-convergence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Note that the notion of convergence defined above does not come from a metric or norm.
blocks.zh: 注意, 上面定义的收敛概念并不来自度量或范数.
blocks.label: rem:test-function-convergence-nonmetric

blocks.en: Indeed, this example can be used generate other examples of test functions. The following theorem states that any continuous function of compact support can be approximated uniformly by test functions.
blocks.zh: 事实上, 可以利用这一例子生成其他试验函数的例子. 以下定理指出, 任意具有紧支集的连续函数均可由试验函数一致逼近.

blocks.en: In a similar fashion, we can construct test functions which are equal to 1 on a given set and equal to 0 on another.
blocks.zh: 以类似方式, 可以构造在给定集合上等于 1, 在另一集合上等于 0 的试验函数.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $K$ be a compact subset of $\Omega$ and let $U\subset\Omega$ be an open set containing $K$. Then there is a test function which is equal to 1 on $K$, is equal to 0 outside $U$ and assumes values in $[0,1]$ on $U\setminus K$.
blocks.zh: 设 $K$ 为 $\Omega$ 的紧子集, 且 $U\subset\Omega$ 为包含 $K$ 的开集. 那么存在一个试验函数, 它在 $K$ 上等于 1, 在 $U$ 外等于 0, 并在 $U\setminus K$ 上取值于 $[0,1]$.
blocks.label: thm:smooth-cutoff

blocks.en: Many proofs in PDEs involve a reduction to local considerations in a small neighborhood of a point. (See, for example, Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations}.) The device by which this is achieved is known as a partition of unity.
blocks.zh: 偏微分方程中的许多证明涉及归结为在某一点的小邻域内作局部考察. (例如见 Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations}.) 实现这一归结的工具称为单位分解.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:partition-of-unity

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The following theorem says that such partitions of unity exist.
blocks.zh: 以下定理指出, 这样的单位分解存在.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $U_i$, $i\in\mathbb{N}$ be a collection of sets with the properties stated in Definition~\ref{def:partition-of-unity}. Then there is a partition of unity subordinate to the covering $\{U_i\}$.
blocks.zh: 设集合族 $U_i$, $i\in\mathbb{N}$ 具有 Definition~\ref{def:partition-of-unity} 中陈述的性质. 那么存在从属于覆盖 $\{U_i\}$ 的单位分解.
blocks.label: thm:partition-of-unity-existence
